facts.fact: Max 当众演示冷铁变形：吹个吻激活后，臂甲三秒化作黑箭，满桌军官倒吸冷气。
facts.anchor: In three seconds, the bracer was gone. An arrow lay across my palm.

facts.fact: Aelindor 向全军介绍 Coldiron：Rupture 后现世，传说源于 Lucifer Morningstar 坠落或垂死恒星之心，有知觉、只应答 Cadet Max 一人。
Aelindor 披露列车顶真相：大恶魔射出冷铁箭，Max 徒手拦截救了他一命——满室军官自此对她刮目相看。
facts.anchor: Without her intervention, the Coldiron would have ended me. I owe her my life.

facts.fact: Drakken 抛出战略炸弹：十年间 Crimson Ridge 流出的 Stormglass 约一半在分子级休眠掺入 Coldiron，受令才激活。
facts.anchor: Approximately half of all Stormglass distributed from the mine contains dormant Coldiron, embedded at the molecular level.

facts.fact: 无人知晓、无人能探测、无人能激活这批污染——Drakken 一句 Except for Cadet Max 收尾，全室目光钉在她身上。
facts.anchor: No one else knows about the corruption. No one else can detect it. And no one else can activate it.

facts.fact: 被满桌军事头脑当作制胜武器盯住，Max 心底发凉——这个词又冷又沉地落进她脑中。
facts.anchor: I wasn’t just any weapon but the weapon.

facts.fact: Aelindor 当众定调：Max 远不止是资产——对他、对继承人们都重要得多，而她的真实角色永远不进简报。
facts.anchor: “She means more than that to me. To the heirs.”

facts.fact: Commander Lee 想把冷铁箭收进军械库编目，Max 压着吼回「它是我的」，Caspian 金眸一闪镇场，箭归还。
